report_meta.h1_raw: # UX Review Report — Thanh toán dư nợ thẻ

screens.screen_name: SCR-TDN-001 — Danh sách thẻ › Danh sách

checks.check: Carousel touch targets (arrows ←→) ≥ 44×44px
checks.evidence: DDL `Fitts's Law`: touch targets ≥ 44dp. Vision: carousel arrows appear ~32px wide. Below minimum.

checks.check: Tab bar touch targets ≥ 44px height
checks.evidence: Vision: tab area appears ~56px height. Acceptable.

checks.check: Masked data reveal (eye icon) has ARIA label
checks.evidence: Cannot verify ARIA from wireframe. Needs code review.

checks.check: Card carousel: scroll position persists on back navigation
checks.evidence: State persistence not visible in wireframe.

checks.check: "Thẻ tín dụng ③" badge is dynamic
checks.evidence: Evidence: badge count appears hardcoded in Figma design. Should reflect actual card count.

checks.check: Hạn mức masked by default (security)
checks.evidence: Vision: "******** VND" masked by default. Eye icon for reveal. Correct pattern.

checks.check: 4 service tabs: labels not truncated
checks.evidence: Vision: "Thanh toán thẻ tín dụng" label appears long — risk of truncation on small screens.

checks.check: "Chi tiết thẻ" CTA: full-width, high contrast
checks.evidence: Vision: full-width dark blue CTA with white text. Good contrast.

screens.screen_name: SCR-TDN-002 — Thanh toán dư nợ › Form nhập thông tin

checks.check: Radio group: default selection = minimum payment
checks.evidence: Vision: "Dư nợ tối thiểu kỳ sao kê" selected (filled radio). Correct safe default.

checks.check: Radio options: amounts visible without scrolling
checks.evidence: Vision: all 4 options visible in one viewport. No scrolling needed.

checks.check: Prefilled text "Thanh toán the tin dung" — correct spelling
checks.evidence: Vision: "Thanh toán the tin dung" clearly visible — missing diacritics. Should be "Thanh toán thẻ tín dụng".

checks.check: Char counter "30/160" realtime
checks.evidence: Counter present in design. Realtime behavior requires code verification.

checks.check: Account dropdown: shows current balance
checks.evidence: Vision: balance "20,000,000 VND" shown but no loading indicator if stale.

checks.check: "Tiếp tục" CTA disabled when balance insufficient
checks.evidence: CTA state logic not verifiable from static wireframe.

checks.check: "Số tiền khác" shows max constraint inline
checks.evidence: Vision: "Tối đa: 1,510,000 VND" visible under Số tiền khác radio.

checks.check: Radio touch targets ≥ 44px
checks.evidence: Vision: radio rows appear ~48px height. Acceptable.

checks.check: Text input "Nội dung GD": accessible label visible
checks.evidence: Vision: "Nội dung giao dịch" label clearly above input field.

screens.screen_name: SCR-TDN-003 — Thanh toán dư nợ - Nhập số tiền › Form nhập thông tin

checks.check: Custom numpad: all keys ≥ 44×44px
checks.evidence: Vision: numpad keys large and well above 44px minimum.

checks.check: Amount input: auto-format with thousand separators
checks.evidence: Vision: input field shows cursor only — no format preview. No comma separator visible in design.

checks.check: Max amount hint visible and prominent
checks.evidence: Vision (Skill C actual): "Tối đa..." color appears very light gray on white — low contrast. Est. contrast ratio fails WCAG AA (4.5:1).

checks.check: Error dialog "Thông báo": clear recovery action
checks.evidence: Vision confirmed: button "Đóng" — ambiguous action. Should be "Nhập lại" to retain context. DDL `UXG error_recovery`.

checks.check: Error dialog: dimmed overlay retains base context
checks.evidence: Vision: base screen visible behind dimmed overlay. User retains context. Good pattern.

checks.check: Numpad: backspace key (⌫) accessible
checks.evidence: Vision: backspace key visible in bottom-right of numpad.

checks.check: Amount validation realtime (before submit)
checks.evidence: Static wireframe — realtime validation not verifiable.

checks.check: Numpad layout: consistent 3×4 grid across flow
checks.evidence: Vision (Skill C — NEW): numpad-1 spec requires uniform 3×4 grid. Actual: key "0" spans double width. Also: 2 different numpad styles used in same flow (Amount vs PIN) — inconsistency.

screens.screen_name: SCR-TDN-004 — Thanh toán dư nợ - Xác nhận › Xác nhận giao dịch

checks.check: [DDL otp-input-1] `canResend` state: resend button visible
checks.evidence: DDL `otp-input-1` spec requires `canResend` state + 'Gửi lại'/resend button. Vision: PIN overlay has 6 cells + numpad + "Xác nhận" only. NO resend UI.

checks.check: [DDL otp-input-1] `timeLeft` state: countdown timer visible
checks.evidence: DDL `otp-input-1` spec has `timeLeft: 60` default. Vision: no countdown timer visible in PIN overlay.

checks.check: [DDL otp-input-1] `activeIndex`: visual focus indicator on active cell
checks.evidence: Vision: first cell shows cursor `

checks.check: PIN cells: minimum 44×44px touch target
checks.evidence: DDL `otp-input-1` spec: cellSize=48px. Vision: 6 cells across ~320px width → ~53px per cell. Acceptable width but height may vary.

checks.check: PIN lockout warning displayed prominently
checks.evidence: Vision: "PIN thẻ sẽ bị khóa nếu nhập sai PIN 5 lần liên tiếp" clearly visible above CTA.

checks.check: Remaining attempts counter after incorrect PIN
checks.evidence: Vision: warning text static — no dynamic "Còn X lần" counter. Critical for trust.

checks.check: "Xác nhận" summary: amount prominently displayed
checks.evidence: Vision: "1,500,000 VND" in summary table. Visible. (Note: formatting could be larger)

checks.check: Auth method selector (Soft OTP) is changeable
checks.evidence: Vision: dropdown ▼ visible. User can change auth method.

checks.check: PIN input: no copy/paste allowed
checks.evidence: Security behavior not verifiable from static wireframe.

checks.check: Transaction note spelling error on confirm screen
checks.evidence: Vision: "Thanh toán the tin dung" — carries over from form. Must fix upstream.

checks.check: PIN overlay: X close button accessible
checks.evidence: Vision: X close button visible top-right of "Xác thực giao dịch" overlay.

checks.check: Confirmation instruction text visible
checks.evidence: Vision: blue banner "Quý khách vui lòng kiểm tra thông tin giao dịch đã khởi tạo" visible and prominent.

screens.screen_name: SCR-TDN-005 — Thanh toán dư nợ - Kết quả › Kết quả giao dịch

checks.check: Success state: checkmark icon prominent
checks.evidence: Vision: large green checkmark circle. Clear success signal per Peak-End Rule.

checks.check: Transaction amount matches confirmed amount
checks.evidence: Vision: "500,000 VND" on result. Confirmed amount on SCR-TDN-004 was "1,500,000 VND". Data inconsistency — must verify with real API data.

checks.check: "n giờ" processing time: should be specific
checks.evidence: Vision: "sẽ được cập nhật trong n giờ" — "n" is literal placeholder. Doherty Threshold: users need specific timeframe. Should show "2-4 giờ làm việc".

checks.check: Transaction ID: copyable
checks.evidence: Vision: "12312323" displayed in red. Copy icon not visible. Should have tap-to-copy.

checks.check: Share action: PII masked before sharing
checks.evidence: Cannot verify share behavior from wireframe. Code must mask account numbers before share.

checks.check: Receipt fields complete: timestamp, amount, source, ID, note
checks.evidence: Vision: all 6 fields present (Thời gian, Tài khoản, Tên, Mã GD, Nội dung). Complete receipt.

checks.check: "Tạo giao dịch mới" CTA: secondary styling (not competing with back/home)
checks.evidence: Vision: outlined button (not filled). Correctly de-emphasized vs main receipt content.

screens.screen_name: SCR-TDN-006 — Danh sách sao kê thẻ › Danh sách

checks.check: List items: tap target ≥ 44px height
checks.evidence: Vision: list rows appear ~60px height. Acceptable.

checks.check: [DDL empty-state-1] Empty state: has illustration
checks.evidence: DDL `empty-state-1` spec requires icon + title + description + optional CTA. Vision: empty state has text only — NO illustration, NO action button.

checks.check: Empty state: action button for next step
checks.evidence: Vision: empty state "Quý khách chưa có sao kê..." — no action. Should have "Xem thẻ khác" or expected date.

checks.check: PDF file icon: distinguishable from other icons
checks.evidence: Vision: red PDF icon per item. Clearly distinguishable.

checks.check: Chevron right: navigational affordance clear
checks.evidence: Vision: > chevrons visible. Standard iOS/Android navigation pattern.

checks.check: No date of statement publication shown
checks.evidence: Vision: only month/year label (e.g., "Sao kê tháng 11/2025"). No file size, no date.

screens.screen_name: SCR-TDN-007 — Chi tiết sao kê - Hệ thống › Chi tiết

checks.check: App navigation bar retained in system viewer
checks.evidence: Vision: blank screen with only "Xem file sao kê thẻ" text. No app header, no back button. User loses navigation context.

checks.check: Loading state for PDF content
checks.evidence: Vision: placeholder only. No loading indicator visible in design.

checks.check: Error state if PDF fails to load
checks.evidence: Vision: no error state designed. Need: "Không thể tải file" + "Thử lại" button.

checks.check: Breadcrumb: which statement user is viewing
checks.evidence: Vision: no title showing "Sao kê tháng 11/2025". User loses context.
